title: Crystal Structure Prediction of Binary Alloys via Deep Potential.
summary: Deep Potential-guided structure search proposed Al–Mg phases supported by DFT refinement; the results are theoretical candidates, not experimentally synthesized materials.
ai_technology: A learned Deep Potential supplies the energy surface for global alloy structure search.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.unknown: DFT refinement, convex-hull calculations and stability analyses evaluate the predicted structures; no experimental synthesis is claimed.
